text: dsh-quarto-book 是面向 Quarto Book 项目的 DSH 插件，提供章节写作与主题维护技能，以及渲染检查和收尾回执工具。它只在当前会话所在的 Git 书籍工作区中呈现技能，要求 _quarto.yml 声明 type: book 且存在章节源文件。写作技能按九步流程处理章节，主题技能维护书籍样式；quarto_render_check 可按需渲染并检查 HTML，quarto_pass_report 将操作结果整理成固定回执。适合编写中文技术书、调整阅读主题并核验发布产物的用户。安装需要 DSH 与 Node.js；实际渲染检查需要 Quarto CLI。

dsh-quarto-book adds chapter-writing and theme-design skills for Quarto Book projects, plus tools to check rendered HTML and summarize completed work. Skills appear in eligible book workspaces. Rendering checks require Quarto CLI; installation requires DSH and Node.js.
想按一套清晰步骤写完 Quarto 书籍章节。
帮我润色技术书章节，但别改动里面的事实和代码。
我想统一 Quarto Book 的字体、配色、导航和 Callout 样式。
渲染完后怎么检查书的 HTML 是否能发布？
Help me plan and revise chapters in a Quarto book using a repeatable workflow.
I need to check a rendered Quarto book and get a concise summary of the work.
dsh-quarto-book 的「章节写作」功能：writing-quarto 按九步流程指导 Quarto Book 章节起稿、改写、润色和审阅；调用技能后根据当前任务进入对应步骤。
dsh-quarto-book 的「主题维护」功能：designing-theme 指导调整 Quarto Book 的颜色、字体、间距、导航及 Callout 样式；在主题任务中调用技能并按主题步骤处理。
dsh-quarto-book 的「渲染验收与回执」功能：调用 quarto_render_check 检查或按需渲染书籍并查看 HTML 报告，再用 quarto_pass_report 汇总技能、改动和检查结论。

@chengzhao-dev/dsh-quarto-book README · dsh-quarto-book：[](https://github.com/chengzhao-dev/dsh-quarto-book/actions/workflows/publish.yml)
[](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@chengzhao-dev/dsh-quarto-book)

[English](https://github.com/chengzhao-dev/dsh-quarto-book/blob/main/README.en.md) | **简体中文**

把一份 Quarto Book 从章节写到可发布：`writing-quarto` 负责章节骨架、整书次序与中文行文，`designing-theme` 负责主题；渲染后由 `quarto_render_check` 判断 HTML 是否可发布，`quarto_pass_report` 给出收尾回执。两个技能只在 `type: book` 的仓库里出现，运行需要 Quarto CLI 与 Python 3。

@chengzhao-dev/dsh-quarto-book README · 提供什么：| 名称 | 用途 | 不做什么 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `writing-quarto` | 新建或修改 `content/**/*.qmd`、`index.qmd`、`_quarto.yml`；章节骨架、中文行文、代码与图表、内容检查 | 不改 CSS、字体和颜色 |
| `designing-theme` | 调整主题的 CSS、SCSS、字体、palette、导航与 Callout 样式 | 不改章节正文 |
| `quarto_render_check` | 先判断 `output-dir` 是否安全，再按需渲染一次，检查 `_book/` 里的 HTML 是否可发布 | 不改 `.qmd`，不自动修配置，不重复渲染 |
| `quarto_pass_report` | 收尾时把执行结论压成固定行数的回执卡片：技能、模式、改过的文件与步骤、未改项、检查结论 | 不保存到磁盘，不贴章节原文，不据回执改文章 |

@chengzhao-dev/dsh-quarto-book README · 提供什么：两个技能从包内 `skills/` 目录发现，按需加载；技能里的相对路径以技能目录为基准：`writing-quarto` 用 `steps/`、`writing/`、`writing/examples/`、`quarto/`、`scripts/`，`designing-theme` 用 `theme/`、`assets/`、`scripts/`。

@chengzhao-dev/dsh-quarto-book README · 快速开始：1. 安装插件：

```bash
   dsh plugin --profile web add npm:@chengzhao-dev/dsh-quarto-book@latest
   ```

2. 在书仓库里打开会话。`_quarto.yml` 要有独立一行的 `type: book`，书根至少有一个 `.qmd` 或 `.md` 章节源文件；两个技能名这时才会出现。
3. 调用技能：写正文用 `writing-quarto`，改主题用 `designing-theme`。

@chengzhao-dev/dsh-quarto-book README · 快速开始：`--profile` 换成你实际运行的那个 profile。桌面应用固定跑 `desktop` profile，且该 profile 由应用独占管理，`dsh --profile desktop` 直接启动会被拒绝；安装或升级用 `dsh plugin --profile desktop add <包>`，应用拒绝写入时再走「设置 → 插件 → 添加插件」。需要固定版本时写 `npm:@chengzhao-dev/dsh-quarto-book@0.6.23`，跟 GitHub 标签时写 `github:chengzhao-dev/dsh-quarto-book#v0.6.23`。

@chengzhao-dev/dsh-quarto-book README · 快速开始：从旧的无作用域包 `dsh-quarto-book` 升级（该包已随 0.3.4 从 npm 删除，只影响之前装过它的 profile）：先在同一个 profile 里 `dsh plugin --profile <profile> remove dsh-quarto-book`，再装新包。两个包同时留着会以相同的 rank 550 各注册一遍 `writing-quarto` 和 `designing-theme`。

安装单位是 profile，不是仓库：只影响执行 `add` 的那个 profile。装好之后还要过工作区检查：按会话 `cwd` 判断当前目录是不是一本书，通过后技能名才会出现。检查的六类情形见 [docs/plugin-boundaries.md](https://github.com/chengzhao-dev/dsh-quarto-book/blob/main/docs/plugin-boundaries.md)。

@chengzhao-dev/dsh-quarto-book README · 环境要求：| 依赖 | 用途 |
| --- | --- |
| DSH 0.2.x | 宿主；插件按 `dsh.bundle.patch` 注册技能与两个工具 |
| Node.js 22 及以上 | 运行插件与检查脚本 |
| Python 3 | 内容、链接、命名检查，以及渲染后的 HTML 检查 |
| Quarto CLI | 仅 `quarto_render_check` 真正渲染时需要 |

发布包已经带编译好的 `lib/`，安装后不需要构建。环境分工见 [docs/plugin-layout.md](https://github.com/chengzhao-dev/dsh-quarto-book/blob/main/docs/plugin-layout.md)。

@chengzhao-dev/dsh-quarto-book README · 改主题：主题资产在 `skills/designing-theme/assets/theme/`，包内是权威来源，书内 `theme/` 是渲染副本。已有副本时 `designing-theme` 只改副本；只有用户明确要求「把插件主题装进这本书」且目标目录不存在，才从包复制，并把 `skills/writing-quarto/scripts/answering-disclosure.lua` 放到书内 `filters/answering-disclosure.lua`。`_quarto.yml` 只引用书内副本，不指向 npm 包或插件检出目录。

@chengzhao-dev/dsh-quarto-book README · 检查与渲染：内容与链接检查在 `writing-quarto` 技能目录下运行：

```bash
python scripts/verifying-content.py --root <book>
python scripts/checking-links.py --root <book>
python scripts/checking-prose.py --root <book>
python scripts/checking-names.py --root <book>

`checking-prose.py` 只报中文混排里能直接判断的问题；`checking-names.py` 只在全仓改写时加跑。日常章节检查跑前三条即可。

@chengzhao-dev/dsh-quarto-book README · 检查与渲染：渲染后的 Callout、HTML 产物与 DOM 结构约定由 `quarto_render_check` 调包内脚本完成，不用手跑 `checking-callouts.py`、`checking-output.py` 或 `checking-dom.py`；`designing-theme` 的 `scripts/checking-layout.py` 在渲染后的 HTML 上检查溢出、对比度和页面结构。`apply()` 不在加载时跑这些脚本，也不跑 `quarto render`。

一轮结束时调用一次 `quarto_pass_report`，把这次执行的结论压成卡片；卡片就是回执，回复里不再复述。

@chengzhao-dev/dsh-quarto-book README · 项目技能：项目只放一份自己的约定技能：`<book>/.agents/skills/quarto-book-project/`，模板见 `templates/quarto-book-project/`。存在时两个通用技能先读它的 `SKILL.md`，再按它指向的 `writing/` 文件读章节表；不存在就跳过，不猜项目约定。

**不要把同名技能嵌进书仓库**：DSH 在同一技能层按 rank 取一个，`.agents/skills`（rank 200）优先于插件（rank 550），书里再放 `writing-quarto` 或 `designing-theme` 会让插件正文失效。

| --- | --- |
| [docs/architecture.md](https://github.com/chengzhao-dev/dsh-quarto-book/blob/main/docs/architecture.md) | 两个技能与两个工具的分层、四个域（内容、结构、版式、措辞）与文件职责 |

| [docs/plugin-boundaries.md](https://github.com/chengzhao-dev/dsh-quarto-book/blob/main/docs/plugin-boundaries.md) | 工作区检查的六类情形与判定顺序 |
| [docs/plugin-layout.md](https://github.com/chengzhao-dev/dsh-quarto-book/blob/main/docs/plugin-layout.md) | 仓库目录、发布包内容与 Python/Quarto 分工 |
| [docs/writing-quarto-layout.md](https://github.com/chengzhao-dev/dsh-quarto-book/blob/main/docs/writing-quarto-layout.md) | 写作技能的目录分层 |
| [docs/triggering.md](https://github.com/chengzhao-dev/dsh-quarto-book/blob/main/docs/triggering.md) | 两个技能的触发判据、四个域与正反例 |
| [docs/versioning.md](https://github.com/chengzhao-dev/dsh-quarto-book/blob/main/docs/versioning.md) | 版本号与发布顺序 |

@chengzhao-dev/dsh-quarto-book README · 开发：源码用 TypeScript，构建产物 `lib/` 提交进仓库；发布包直接加载 `lib/`，安装后不需要构建。开发时把本仓库链接进写书用的 profile，而不是把技能复制进书：

```bash
npm ci
npm test
npm run check
npm run pack

`npm test` 会先编译再跑工具测试；`npm run check` 做类型检查与技能路径自检；`npm run pack` 把 tarball 只写进 `temp/`，那个目录已在 `.gitignore` 里。

推送前用一条命令复现 CI 的检查序列：

```bash
npm run ci
```

`npm run ci` 依次执行 `npm ci`、`npm test`、`npm run check:lib`、`npm run check` 与 `npm run pack:check`，覆盖 `.github/workflows/ci.yml` 的全部步骤，并在打包前挡住发布内容的问题。

开发安装：

@chengzhao-dev/dsh-quarto-book README · 开发：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add D:\\Github\\dsh-quarto-book
```

`SKILL.md`、`steps/`、`examples/`、`quarto/` 在下一次 `skill` 工具调用时重读，改完不用发 npm。包内主题改动不会自动进书的 HTML；要看页面效果，把改过的文件同步到书的 `theme/`，再在书根运行 `quarto render`。不要把 `_quarto.yml` 指到插件检出目录，那条路径换机器就不存在。

插件以 bundle 形式发布：`package.json` 的 `dsh.bundle.patch` 指向 `cordis.patch.yml`，补丁只插入 `id: quarto-book`、`name: '@chengzhao-dev/dsh-quarto-book'` 一行。入口不 import 宿主实现，因此在 pnpm 的严格依赖布局下也能加载。
@chengzhao-dev/dsh-quarto-book README · 开发：旧装机脚本 `scripts/embedding-agents.ps1` 会把两棵技能原样复制进目标仓库的 `.agents/`，按 rank 200 盖住插件；新书不要用它，只有离线归档独立技能树时才执行，命令写在脚本头部。

@chengzhao-dev/dsh-quarto-book README · 问题与贡献：问题与建议走 [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/chengzhao-dev/dsh-quarto-book/issues)。提交改动前先运行 `npm test` 与 `npm run check`；涉及技能正文时，同时跑 `node scripts/checking-skill-links.mjs`。
@chengzhao-dev/dsh-quarto-book README · 许可：MIT。主题内的 LXGW Bright 与 LXGW Bright Code 按 SIL Open Font License 1.1 使用；上游版权声明与许可全文在 `skills/designing-theme/assets/theme/assets/fonts/OFL.txt`。

@chengzhao-dev/dsh-quarto-book README · dsh-quarto-book：Take a Quarto Book from chapters to publishable output: `writing-quarto` owns the chapter skeleton, whole-book order and Chinese prose; `designing-theme` owns the theme; after a render, `quarto_render_check` decides whether the HTML is publishable and `quarto_pass_report` prints the closing receipt. Both skills appear only inside `type: book` repositories, and the workflow needs Quarto CLI and Python 3.

@chengzhao-dev/dsh-quarto-book README · What it provides：| Name | Use it for | Out of scope |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `writing-quarto` | Creating or editing `content/**/*.qmd`, `index.qmd`, `_quarto.yml`; chapter skeletons, Chinese prose, code and figures, content checks | CSS, fonts and colours |
| `designing-theme` | Theme CSS, SCSS, fonts, palettes, navigation and callout styling | Chapter prose |
| `quarto_render_check` | Check that `output-dir` is safe, render once when asked, and inspect HTML in `_book/` for publishing | Editing `.qmd`, fixing config automatically, or re-running a failed render |
| `quarto_pass_report` | Compress the run into a fixed-line receipt card: skill, mode, files and steps changed, items held, check verdicts | Saving to disk, quoting chapter prose, or changing the text based on the receipt |

@chengzhao-dev/dsh-quarto-book README · What it provides：Both skills are discovered from the package's `skills/` directory and loaded on demand. Relative paths inside a skill resolve against that skill's directory: `writing-quarto` uses `steps/`, `writing/`, `writing/examples/`, `quarto/`, `scripts/`; `designing-theme` uses `theme/`, `assets/`, `scripts/`.

@chengzhao-dev/dsh-quarto-book README · Quick start：1. Install the plugin:

```bash
   dsh plugin --profile web add npm:@chengzhao-dev/dsh-quarto-book@latest
   ```

2. Open a session in the book repository. `_quarto.yml` needs a standalone `type: book` line, and the book needs at least one `.qmd` or `.md` chapter source; only then do both skill names appear.
3. Call a skill: `writing-quarto` for prose, `designing-theme` for the theme.

@chengzhao-dev/dsh-quarto-book README · Quick start：Replace `--profile` with the profile you actually run. The desktop app always runs the `desktop` profile, and that profile is owned by the app, so `dsh --profile desktop` is rejected; install or upgrade with `dsh plugin --profile desktop add <package>`, and use the app's Settings → Plugins → Add plugin only if the app refuses that write. To pin a version, write `npm:@chengzhao-dev/dsh-quarto-book@0.6.23`; to follow a GitHub tag, write `github:chengzhao-dev/dsh-quarto-book#v0.6.23`.

@chengzhao-dev/dsh-quarto-book README · Quick start：Upgrading from the old unscoped package `dsh-quarto-book` (removed from npm with 0.3.4, so this only affects profiles that installed it earlier): remove it from the same profile first with `dsh plugin --profile <profile> remove dsh-quarto-book`, then add the scoped package. Keeping both installed registers `writing-quarto` and `designing-theme` twice at the same rank 550.

@chengzhao-dev/dsh-quarto-book README · Quick start：Installation is scoped to a profile, not to a repository: it only affects the profile that ran `add`. The workspace check still decides whether the two skill names appear: it checks the session `cwd` for a book, and only then are both names selectable. See [docs/plugin-boundaries.md](https://github.com/chengzhao-dev/dsh-quarto-book/blob/main/docs/plugin-boundaries.md) for the six cases.

@chengzhao-dev/dsh-quarto-book README · Requirements：| Dependency | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| DSH 0.2.x | Host; the plugin registers skills and both tools through `dsh.bundle.patch` |
| Node.js 22 or newer | Plugin runtime and check scripts |
| Python 3 | Content, link and naming checks, plus post-render HTML checks |
| Quarto CLI | Only when `quarto_render_check` actually renders |

@chengzhao-dev/dsh-quarto-book README · Requirements：The published package already contains compiled `lib/`, so installation needs no build step. See [docs/plugin-layout.md](https://github.com/chengzhao-dev/dsh-quarto-book/blob/main/docs/plugin-layout.md) for the split.

@chengzhao-dev/dsh-quarto-book README · Writing chapters：Load `writing-quarto` in a `type: book` repository and follow the nine steps in `SKILL.md`. Each step opens one same-numbered file in `steps/`; read the same-numbered case in `examples/` only when a signal is unclear; open `quarto/` only for figures, render checks or repository-wide refactors.

@chengzhao-dev/dsh-quarto-book README · Writing chapters：The repository's root `README.md` is a description page, not a chapter: it takes only steps 5–8, skips the task skeleton and structure of steps 1–4, has no "common errors" or "self-test questions", and never calls `quarto_render_check`. `README.en.md` is treated the same way.

@chengzhao-dev/dsh-quarto-book README · Writing chapters：The plugin has no daemon and does not run skills when a session starts. A skill name in the catalog only means the check passed; only calling `skill`, `quarto_render_check` or `quarto_pass_report` counts as use. A second call in the same session re-reads the skill body, and failed tools are not retried automatically.

@chengzhao-dev/dsh-quarto-book README · Theming：Theme assets live in `skills/designing-theme/assets/theme/`. The package copy is authoritative; a book's `theme/` is the render copy. When a copy exists, `designing-theme` edits only that copy. It copies from the package only when the user explicitly asks to install the theme into the book and the target directory does not exist, and it also places `skills/writing-quarto/scripts/answering-disclosure.lua` at `filters/answering-disclosure.lua`. `_quarto.yml` always references the in-book copy, never an npm package or a checkout path.

@chengzhao-dev/dsh-quarto-book README · Checks and rendering：Run the content and link checks from the `writing-quarto` skill directory:

```bash
python scripts/verifying-content.py --root <book>
python scripts/checking-links.py --root <book>
python scripts/checking-prose.py --root <book>
python scripts/checking-names.py --root <book>

`checking-prose.py` reports only mixed Chinese-English problems that can be judged directly; `checking-names.py` is for repository-wide refactors. For everyday chapter work, the first three are enough.

@chengzhao-dev/dsh-quarto-book README · Checks and rendering：Post-render callouts, HTML output and DOM contracts are checked by `quarto_render_check`, which calls the bundled scripts; run `checking-callouts.py`, `checking-output.py` or `checking-dom.py` by hand only when debugging a script. `designing-theme`'s `scripts/checking-layout.py` checks overflow, contrast and page structure on rendered HTML. Neither tool runs those scripts at load time, and neither runs `quarto render`.
@chengzhao-dev/dsh-quarto-book README · Checks and rendering：Call `quarto_pass_report` once at the end of a run; the card is the receipt, and the reply should not repeat it.

@chengzhao-dev/dsh-quarto-book README · Project skill：A project keeps its own conventions in one skill: `<book>/.agents/skills/quarto-book-project/`, with a template in `templates/quarto-book-project/`. When it exists, both generic skills read its `SKILL.md` first, then the `writing/` files it points to; when it does not exist, they skip it and do not guess.

@chengzhao-dev/dsh-quarto-book README · Project skill：**Do not vendor a same-named skill into the book repository.** DSH picks one skill per name at its rank: `.agents/skills` (rank 200) wins over the plugin (rank 550), so a copy of `writing-quarto` or `designing-theme` inside the book silently replaces the plugin's rules.

| [docs/plugin-boundaries.md](https://github.com/chengzhao-dev/dsh-quarto-book/blob/main/docs/plugin-boundaries.md) | The six workspace-check cases and their order |
| [docs/plugin-layout.md](https://github.com/chengzhao-dev/dsh-quarto-book/blob/main/docs/plugin-layout.md) | Repository layout, package contents, and the Python/Quarto split |

@chengzhao-dev/dsh-quarto-book README · Development：The source is TypeScript and the compiled `lib/` is committed; the published package loads `lib/` directly and needs no build on install. Link this checkout into the profile you write books with instead of copying skills into the book:

```bash
npm ci
npm test
npm run check
npm run pack

`npm test` compiles and runs the tool tests; `npm run check` type-checks and validates skill paths; `npm run pack` writes the tarball into `temp/`, which is already in `.gitignore`.

@chengzhao-dev/dsh-quarto-book README · Development：Replay the CI sequence locally with one command before pushing:

```bash
npm run ci
```

It runs `npm ci`, `npm test`, `npm run check:lib`, `npm run check`, and `npm run pack:check` — the same steps as `.github/workflows/ci.yml`, plus the publish-time package gate.

Development install:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add D:\\Github\\dsh-quarto-book
```

@chengzhao-dev/dsh-quarto-book README · Development：`SKILL.md`, `steps/`, `examples/` and `quarto/` are re-read on the next `skill` call, so rule changes need no npm publish. Theme changes in the package do not reach a book's HTML by themselves: copy the changed files into the book's `theme/` and run `quarto render` in the book root. Do not point `_quarto.yml` at the checkout; that path does not exist on another machine.

@chengzhao-dev/dsh-quarto-book README · Development：The plugin ships as a bundle: `package.json` has `dsh.bundle.patch` pointing at `cordis.patch.yml`, and the patch inserts only the `id: quarto-book`, `name: '@chengzhao-dev/dsh-quarto-book'` line. The entry does not import host internals, so it also loads under pnpm's strict dependency layout.

@chengzhao-dev/dsh-quarto-book README · Development：The legacy `scripts/embedding-agents.ps1` copies both skill trees into a target repository's `.agents/`, which shadows the plugin at rank 200. Do not use it for new books; run it only to archive a standalone skill tree offline. The command is at the top of the script.

@chengzhao-dev/dsh-quarto-book README · Issues and contributing：Bugs and suggestions go to [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/chengzhao-dev/dsh-quarto-book/issues). Before sending a change, run `npm test` and `npm run check`; for skill prose, also run `node scripts/checking-skill-links.mjs`.
